searchText: Terminated last few of my zinken nodes, and the eth2stats, etc. We are right around the corner of a v1.0.0 devnet, then larger public but dev-controlled ones follow after. For now I would recommend helping find clients issues on medalla, and then later test your setup when we open up a longer devnet. We plan to maintain more nodes there, so it can withstand the inevitable higher validator online/offline fluctuations of mainnet launch prep. moving zinken to the graveyard. Speak now or forever hold your peace https://m.interglot.com/nl/en/zinken Zinken held up surprisingly well, the name was the opposite to me. Bye zinken
